description: Aider-polyglot style (JavaScript), built for the repair round: a synchronous event emitter with once, off by original function, unsubscribe handles and error handling. The natural first implementation loops over the live listener array (or forEach with splice) and so skips the listener after one that removes itself or is removed mid-emit, and it lets the first throwing listener abort the rest; the tests catch both, so the post-turn verifier's second round has to fix them.
